content.value_statement: Generic AI layouts often look flat and template driven. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code toward premium visual systems, motion rules, and responsive UI polish.
actual_capabilities: Defines premium UI archetypes for glass, editorial, and soft structural visual styles.
Provides layout patterns for bento grids, layered cascades, and editorial splits.
Specifies card shells, CTA buttons, floating navigation, hover states, and scroll reveals.
Includes mobile collapse rules for asymmetric layouts below 768 pixels.
Adds performance guardrails for animation properties, blur effects, overlays, and z-index use.
limitations: Does not include executable components or reusable design token files.
Assumes premium fonts and light icon sets are available in the project.
May need adjustment for strict brand systems or accessibility requirements.
Focuses on visual execution, not product strategy or content architecture.

use_cases.title: Upgrade a SaaS Dashboard
use_cases.description: Apply premium spacing, layered cards, refined navigation, and motion rules to a functional SaaS interface.

use_cases.title: Create an Agency Landing Page
use_cases.description: Generate a polished marketing page with strong typography, responsive layout, and high-end interaction details.

use_cases.title: Refine Portfolio Presentation
use_cases.description: Turn a basic portfolio into a more editorial, tactile, and mobile-aware visual experience.

prompt_templates.title: Beginner Interface Refresh
prompt_templates.scenario: Improve a simple page without changing the product scope.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use high-end-visual-design to redesign this page with premium spacing, refined typography, responsive layout, and restrained motion.

prompt_templates.title: Component System Polish
prompt_templates.scenario: Make repeated UI elements feel consistent and premium.
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply the skill to improve cards, buttons, navigation, and section rhythm. Keep the existing content and user flow intact.

prompt_templates.title: Responsive Landing Page Build
prompt_templates.scenario: Create a complete first-screen experience and supporting sections.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a premium landing page for this product. Include a strong visual archetype, mobile collapse behavior, and performance-conscious motion.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced Design Audit
prompt_templates.scenario: Review an existing implementation against premium visual rules.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this interface using high-end-visual-design. Identify weak visual patterns, then revise the layout, motion, and component details.

output_examples.input: A basic SaaS homepage needs a more premium first impression.
output: A darker glass-inspired visual direction with strong whitespace and layered feature panels.
A floating navigation pattern, nested CTA treatment, and staggered reveal behavior.
Mobile rules that collapse asymmetric sections into a clean single-column flow.

output_examples.input: A portfolio page feels generic and needs editorial polish.
output: A refined typography system with larger headings and controlled section rhythm.
An editorial split layout with tactile project cards and subtle motion cues.
Performance notes that keep animation limited to transform and opacity.

best_practices: Pair the skill with a clear audience, brand tone, and product goal before asking for code.
Review generated colors, fonts, and motion against the project design system.
Test mobile layouts and animation performance after applying premium visual patterns.
anti_patterns: Do not use it to override accessibility, usability, or brand requirements.
Do not assume referenced premium fonts or icon libraries exist in every project.
Do not apply heavy blur, large overlays, or complex motion without performance checks.

faq.question: What does this skill help create?
faq.answer: It helps AI assistants create polished web interfaces with premium layout, typography, motion, and responsive behavior.

faq.question: Does it generate working application logic?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on visual design direction and interface implementation details, not backend or business logic.

faq.question: Can I use it with existing brand guidelines?
faq.answer: Yes, but you should provide the brand rules and ask the assistant to preserve them.

faq.question: Is it suitable for mobile design?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill includes explicit mobile collapse rules for complex and asymmetric layouts.

faq.question: Does it require specific frameworks?
faq.answer: No specific framework is required, but many examples reference React, Tailwind CSS, and motion libraries.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, and Claude Code use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists compatibility with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
